title_en: Shuangliu County People's Procuratorate of Sichuan Province v. Hu Kejin — refusal to pay labor remuneration

full_text_en:
Shuangliu County People's Procuratorate of Sichuan Province v. Hu Kejin — crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration

【Ruling Summary】

1. A unit or natural person that does not have the qualification as an employer, illegally employs workers and refuses to pay labor remuneration, and absconds after being ordered by relevant government departments to make payment, even if the general contractor of the project advances the labor remuneration, does not affect the investigation of criminal liability for the crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration.

2. The notice of order for rectification issued by the human resources and social security department that contains a representation requiring the actor to "pay labor remuneration" is the legal document that constitutes the precondition for the crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration. Where the actor, after being ordered to pay, refuses to pay labor remuneration by absconding, he or she constitutes the crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration.

Procuratorial Authority: The People's Procuratorate of Shuangliu County, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Hu Kejin, male, 32 years old, Han ethnicity, farmer, residing in Muchuan County, Sichuan Province. Arrested on July 25, 2011 in connection with this case.

The People's Procuratorate of Shuangliu County, Sichuan Province, instituted a public prosecution against the defendant Hu Kejin with the People's Court of Shuangliu County, Sichuan Province, on the ground that he committed the crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration.

The indictment alleged: After the defendant Hu Kejin hired a number of migrant workers to complete construction, he owed wages of over RMB 130,000 to more than 20 migrant workers on the ground that the project incurred losses, and absconded after the social security department ordered him to make payment. The defendant Hu Kejin, by means of absconding, evaded paying labor remuneration to the workers, and the amount was relatively large. After being ordered by the relevant government department to pay, he still failed to pay. His conduct has violated the provisions of Article 276(A) of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and should be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration.

The People's Court of Shuangliu County, Sichuan Province, found after trial at first instance:

In December 2010, the defendant Hu Kejin subcontracted part of the labor project of the Sansheng Feili Mountain Phase I Landscape Project located in Huangshui Town, Shuangliu County, Chengdu City, and subsequently hired a number of migrant workers to work on site. After the project was completed on June 5, 2011, Hu Kejin owed wages of over RMB 120,000 to more than 20 migrant workers, including Li Chaowen, on the ground that the project incurred losses, and failed to pay. On June 9, 2011, the Shuangliu County Human Resources and Social Security Bureau ordered Hu Kejin to pay the back wages owed to the migrant workers. On the evening of that day, Hu Kejin booked airline tickets and, on the morning of the next day, fled with his wife by plane. On June 30, Sichuan Jintianxia Landscape Engineering Co., Ltd. advanced the migrant workers' wages of over RMB 120,000 on behalf of Hu Kejin. On July 12, 2011, the defendant Hu Kejin was arrested in Cixi City, Zhejiang Province.

The above facts were confirmed by the following evidence: the defendant Hu Kejin had no objection during the trial and confessed guilty; the public security authority's acceptance form for criminal cases, decision to place a case on file, record of arrest of the defendant, the defendant Hu Kejin's confession to the public security authority, testimony of 21 migrant workers including witness Li Chaowen, testimony of witnesses Li, He, Liao, and Yang, the wage sheets issued by the defendant Hu Kejin to the migrant workers, the labor subcontracting contract, the project labor unit price table signed by the defendant Hu Kejin and Li, the bill of quantities and project fund advance receipts signed by the defendant Hu Kejin, the interrogation record of the defendant Hu Kejin made by the Shuangliu County Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, the notice of order for rectification issued by the Shuangliu County Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, the explanation of Hu Kejin's wage arrears issued by the Shuangliu County Urban and Rural Construction Bureau and the Shuangliu County Security Supervision Brigade, the receipts for receiving money and wage registration forms issued by more than 20 migrant workers to Sichuan Jintianxia Landscape Engineering Co., Ltd., the explanation of the advance payment of migrant workers' wages by Sichuan Jintianxia Landscape Engineering Co., Ltd. issued by the public security authority, and the permanent resident information form of the defendant Hu Kejin. The evidence was sufficient for identification.

The People's Court of Shuangliu County, Sichuan Province, held at first instance:

The defendant Hu Kejin, by means of absconding, evaded paying labor remuneration to the workers, and the amount was relatively large. After being ordered by the relevant government department to pay, he still failed to pay. His conduct has constituted the crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration. Even though Sichuan Jintianxia Landscape Engineering Co., Ltd. had advanced the wage payment, it does not affect the investigation of Hu Kejin's criminal liability in accordance with law. The charges instituted by the People's Procuratorate of Shuangliu County, Sichuan Province, were established and supported. In view of the fact that the defendant Hu Kejin was a first-time offender and had a good attitude of confession, leniency was appropriately given.

Accordingly, the People's Court of Shuangliu County, Sichuan Province, in accordance with Article 276(A), paragraph 1, Article 52, and Article 53 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment on December 29, 2011:

The defendant Hu Kejin is convicted of the crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of one year, and a fine of RMB 20,000.

After the judgment of first instance was pronounced, the defendant Hu Kejin did not appeal, and the prosecutorial authority did not file a protest. The judgment has become legally effective.
